comment: Independent source-led C-first replacement for the unachievable plan to set u.ulycn through #wizintrinsic. C defines mhitm_ad_were in uhitm.c; the hostile werejackal’s AT_BITE/AD_WERE attack can set the hero’s lycanthropy on rn2(4)==0 when no protection/defense applies. A debug Wizard at level 20 waits in place for the generated werejackal to attack. C must show the actual attack/infection branch and set_ulycn transition; no JavaScript comparison preceded the freeze.
